& Lothianam, Edimburgum usque venit. Classis, ad Fifae mariuma peruastanda,
missa. Militibus Edimburgum volentibus incendere, Dux memor, ante paucos annos
illic se (a suis exclusum) benigne & hospitaliter fuisse tractatum, ignem tectis arcuit.
Non fuit eadem humanitas in copijs nauali bus: nam, AEmonam insulam ingressi,
coenobium Monachorum direptum incenderunt: similique crudelitate vti sunt, in
omnibus locis, in quae exfcenderunt: donec a Nicolao & Thoma Atel kinis, Alexandro
Lindelio, & Gulielmo Cunigamio, multis caelis, quibusdam captis, adeo irepida fuga
in naues fuetant compulsi, vt, praeter alia damna in ea festinatione accepta, quadraginta
fuorum fune nautico, in quo pendebant, caeso, submergi ante oculos suos, permiserint.
Vix Lancastrius domum se receperat, cum Gulielmus Duglassius, prope vestigijs eius
insistens, arcibus, quas Angli in Scoria, post Dunelmensie praelium, tenuerant, part
captis, panim diruiis, Teuiotiam omnem, praeter Rofburgum, Scotis restituit: ac latro-
cinia, per licentiam bellorum graffantia, compescuit: nec ipse diu his rebus superfuit,
febre in aere Duglassiae extinctus. Successit ei Gulielmus Duglassius, filius, omnium viriutis
genere ianio paire dignus. Interea cum annuae inducia propeBoniomian Belgicam fuisent

page.notes: Line numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are printed in the left margin. Small stray marks in the right margin (about lines 22, 27, 33) are not printed text and are left out. The date note at line 41 reads "cIↄ. ccↄ." on the scan; the reading MDLXXXV is my conversion and is doubtful. Greek and Hebrew: none on this page. Several proper names are uncertain (Nicolao, Atel kinis, Cunigamio, Dunelmensie, Rofburgum, Duglassiae, Lindesiorum, Maubraiorum, propeBoniomian) and are not marked with [?] in the text where the scan is only moderately clear; the reader should check them against the original. The word "sent" at the start of line 20 and "fuisent" at line 19 are doubtful. Printing errors such as "irecentesimo", "Teuiotiam", "lera", "ceriotes" are left as printed.
